fiber.label: Business fiber availability ≥100/20 Mbps
fiber.definition: FCC reported county business-location fiber availability at100/20Mbps.
fiber.limits: Reported service availability, not backbone capacity, latency, a leased circuit or a site guarantee. Historical CT retained.

hazards.label: Recorded natural-hazard event density
hazards.period: FEMA NRI November2021; mixed hazard history windows
hazards.definition: Author18-hazard nansum event total divided by source county AREA.
hazards.limits: Replicates missing-component omission in author code; not annual frequency, future probability, severity or expected annual loss.

price.label: State industrial electricity price
price.definition: EIA state industrial average electricity price, shared by counties in that state.
price.limits: State-sector average, not a site tariff, PPA, grid headroom or county-specific price.

water.label: Modeled remaining water depth
water.period: AWARE-US producer baseline; human use2015, runoff1971–2015
water.definition: Sum of twelve AWARE-US producer AMD-with-existing-power monthly depths; source zero floor retained.
water.limits: Historical CONUS counties only; not permitted/purchasable supply. Source Connecticut values are not reassigned.
